threads.body: Raising the minimum from 0.51.0 to 2.1 makes the `instruments` extra incompatible with applications pinned to previously supported Anthropic 0.x or 1.x releases. It also moves the `oldest` test environment to v2 because that environment derives its SDK version from this bound. This PR changes no instrumentation code and gives no feature or fix requiring the higher minimum. Preserve `>=0.51.0` and widen only the upper bound to `<3`, or explicitly justify and document the support removal under the [lower-bound review rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/.github/instructions/build-config.instructions.md#2-lower-bounds). Keep the runtime dependency declaration aligned and regenerate the lockfile after settling the range.
